name.ja: Bトレインショーティー 富士急行1000形 一畑電車2100系
name.en: B Train Shorty Fujikyuko Type 1000 Ichibata Electric Railway 2100 Series

description.ja: • 優れたデザインと状態の良い18メートル級車体、冷房も備えた京王電鉄5000系は、引退後、各地方私鉄から多くの引き合いがあり、譲渡された。
description.en: • After its retirement, the Keio Electric Railway 5000 series, which had an excellent design, an 18-meter class car body in good condition, and air conditioning, received many inquiries from local private railways and was transferred to them.

description.ja: • 富士急行に譲渡され1000形となった車両と、一畑電車に譲渡され2100系となった車両、各１両ずつのセット。
description.en: • A set of one vehicle each, one that was transferred to Fujikyuko and became the 1000 series, and one that was transferred to Ichibata Electric Railway and became the 2100 series.

description.ja: • ２セット購入でそれぞれ２両編成を再現できる。・動力ユニット3対応・走行台車T対応・2両入り
description.en: • By purchasing 2 sets, you can recreate a 2-car formation for each.・Compatible with power unit 3 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
